verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask of an LLM gateway and SDK, so the axis applies. The pack shows no interactive or runnable API reference: the OpenAI spec probes returned 404 at every candidate path, and llms.txt and the CLI docs are different capabilities. The curl-callable MCP REST endpoints are an adjacent feature, not an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
